meta.title: SignalBoard
meta.description: Project overview board: scans local git projects for activity signals, attention items, memos, handoffs and AI weekly-report facts (agent tools + three-view panel)

panel.title: SignalBoard
panel.attention.title: Needs attention
panel.weekly.title: AI Weekly
panel.weekly.empty: No summary generated this week yet
panel.weekly.pending: Requested from the current session; refreshing soon
panel.weekly.needSession: No session available: open one, or type /signalboard-weekly in a session
panel.workbench.title: Workbench
panel.board.title: Projects
panel.board.empty: Scan cache is empty: check scan roots in the desktop app settings, or call signalboard_rescan
panel.board.guide.title: Get started with SignalBoard
panel.board.guide.body: The plugin reads the data directory shared with the desktop app, which currently has no scan roots configured. Add scan roots in the SignalBoard desktop app settings (config.json is the single source of truth; the plugin is read-only).
panel.detail.memo.placeholder: Your own project note (humans write memos; agents write handoffs)
panel.detail.advice.title: AI advice
panel.detail.advice.needSession: No session available: open one first
panel.cmd.memo: Save a project memo (UI-only write face)
panel.cmd.pref: Update panel preferences: pin/order/warning snooze (UI-only write face)
panel.cmd.handoffDone: Mark a handoff entry as done (same function as the agent tool)
panel.cmd.weekly: Ask this session to generate the SignalBoard weekly summary (facts via signalboard_weekly_facts, cached via signalboard_save_summary)
panel.cmd.advice: Ask this session for next-step advice on a project (facts via signalboard_advice_facts, cached via signalboard_save_summary)
